headline: North-West's SLA dropped hard because WH-07's conveyor broke and pickers were short.
body: Our region is the whole story this month — North stayed flat while North-West fell 13 points. The WH-07 conveyor failure cut sortation capacity to 60% and left us 14 pickers short, driving missed deliveries [E5]. Two enterprise accounts, Meridian and Kalinga, already saw late orders and are shifting volume to competitors [E2]. SwiftKart's new express delivery push in our territory may be adding pressure too, but the warehouse breakdown is the bigger issue.

actions.driver: WH-07 conveyor failure and picker shortage
actions.action: Activate 3PL overflow for North-West lanes now
actions.expected_impact: Restore SLA toward baseline within weeks, as seen in East 2025
actions.monitoring: Track daily SLA % and dispatch delay times for WH-07

actions.action: Fast-track hiring to fill 14 picker gap
actions.expected_impact: Rebuild sortation throughput back to normal levels
actions.monitoring: Weekly headcount vs plan and throughput rate at WH-07

what_could_change: Confirmation the conveyor part is installed and pickers hired would strengthen this, while more customer defections would deepen concern.
caveats: We can't yet separate how much SwiftKart's new service is pulling volume versus our own delays.
